name: Camping Seehof
beschreibung: The Seehof campsite is also located in Kramsach, very close to Reintaler See. The site is surrounded by green spaces and offers pitches with lake views. The facilities include modern sanitary amenities and a supply and disposal station for motorhomes. An on-site restaurant serves guests regional dishes. The lake is ideal for swimming and boating. The location is suitable for a quiet holiday in the natural surroundings of Tirol.
